title: Search the RINS neighbourhood

blocks.text: A feeder-reinforcement model maximizes $`\sum_j v_j x_j`$ subject to $`\sum_j c_j x_j \le B`$ and $`x_j \in \{0, 1\}`$. The search has an incumbent plan $`\hat x`$ and an LP optimum $`x^*`$. Write the RINS step for it.
Write `rins(values, costs, budget, incumbent, x)` in `rins.py`. `incumbent` maps each item to 0 or 1 and `x` maps it to its LP value.

items: **Fix where they agree.** Item $`j`$ is fixed at $`\hat x_j`$ when $`|x^*_j - \hat x_j| < 10^{-6}`$; every other item is free.

**Solve the neighbourhood.** Over every 0-1 choice of the free items, with the fixed items at their values, keep the choices whose total cost (fixed items included) is at most $`B`$, and return the sorted list of the items in the most valuable one. On a tie, keep the one found first when the free items, sorted by name, are tried with `itertools.product((0, 1), repeat=...)`.

blocks.text: If no choice fits the budget (it happens only when the items fixed at 1 already cost more than $`B`$, so the incumbent itself broke the budget), there is no plan in the neighbourhood: return `None`, not an empty list, since the empty plan is not in the neighbourhood either. The reference solution does exactly that.
The tests have at most four free items, so trying every choice is fast.

print("plan at budget 9, LP agrees on F1, F4:", rins(values, costs, 9, incumbent, {"F1": 1, "F2": 0.5, "F3": 0.5, "F4": 1}))
print("plan at budget 9, LP agrees on F4 only:", rins(values, costs, 9, incumbent, {"F1": 0.3, "F2": 1, "F3": 1, "F4": 1}))
print("plan at budget 7, LP agrees on all:", rins(values, costs, 7, incumbent, {"F1": 1, "F2": 0, "F3": 0, "F4": 1}))

cases.says: with one variable fixed by agreement, the best plan over the three free ones is returned
when the incumbent and the LP agree nowhere, every item is free and the best plan overall is returned
an LP value of 0.9999999 agrees with an incumbent 1, so that variable stays fixed
an LP value of 0.3 does not agree with an incumbent 0, so that variable is free
when the fixed items alone break the budget, the step returns None
